question: Which 3.1.190 entry pushes an application page (page_goto)?
prototype_hypothesis: page_goto(key, start_data, 0, 0) resolves the key in the page-manager registry and runs the stock transition; it is the body that logs goto_page_no_check_stacktop.
callsite_evidence: String "goto_page_no_check_stacktop" (0x2c76b264) has exactly one code xref, inside sub_C49E274 (0xc49e274), which also logs "Please register this page:%lu!" from the pagemanager tag.

The previously recorded entry 0xc449bc4 is lvx_pagemanager_prelaunch_check (its body logs that tag); it calls sub_C49E274 only after its own prelaunch handling, so pointing the record at it showed no page.
The body matches the o66 goto_page_no_check_stacktop (0xc4e0208) and the n66 one (0xc4b456c): current page lookup, transition, page enter.
unsafe_assumptions: Static evidence only; no device or emulator run has exercised the corrected entry yet.
recommended_probe: Rebuild the n67 Supervisor and open the Manager page on Mirage.
